subject: POC timeline & next steps — ACME Industries
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / POC plan follow-up

Thanks for the call this morning, Marissa — great overview.

Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying items before we lock the POC timeline: 
- Success criteria: 1) baseline latency under 350ms p95 for our typical 512-token prompts, 2) 30% cost reduction vs current endpoint, 3) no data exfiltration and audit logs for all inference calls.
- Evaluation plan: we'll run parallel workload for 2 weeks against a representative dataset (approx 50k queries) and measure latency, cost, and output quality on our labeled prompt set.
- Ownership: I'm the project lead (Alicia), Ben will own data & evaluation scripts.

Open questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide a dedicated environment or a private VPC for the trial?
2) Recommended instance/quantization profile for 512-token workloads?
3) Are weekly check-ins OK (30 min) with a final readout at the end of week 2?

Please confirm and send a proposed kickoff date + agenda.

Thanks,
Alicia
Director, AI Platforms
ACME Industries

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@acme.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / POC plan follow-up

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear summary. Appreciate the ownership callouts. Quick answers inline and proposed next steps.

1) Dedicated env: Yes — we can provision a short-lived dedicated pool inside a customer-dedicated project. For sensitive data we can run in your VPC (private deployment) but that adds about 2-3 days for networking & approvals. For a faster start we suggest dedicated hosted capacity with network restrictions and strict logging.

2) Profile: For 512-token median workload, our recommendation is rtx-a5000 with int8 quantization for the initial run; this gets to ~350ms p95 in our benchmarks. Ethan will confirm expected throughput and batching config.

3) Weekly check-ins: Yes; propose 30-min weekly syncs (Wednesdays 10am PT). Final readout: Fri of week 2.

Attached: initial POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (fills in the metrics you've outlined) and a kickoff agenda PDF.

Proposed kickoff date: Monday, 22 Jun 2026. Can you confirm?

Next steps:
- Alicia/Ben: confirm kickoff date and whether you want VPC or dedicated hosted pool.
- Ethan: confirm SE availability for kickoff and to set up the environment (assigning follow-up tasks).
- I'll schedule calendar invites and share the evaluation tracking sheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / POC plan follow-up

Thanks — I'll be on the kickoff. Quick notes on the infra plan:
- For a 2-week evaluation at 50k queries, dedicated hosted capacity with rtx-a5000 + int8 should meet the latency target and be the fastest to stand up.
- If they require VPC, plan + networking runway is 2-3 business days and we'll need a network contact to finish firewall rules.
- I'll prepare a starter batch config (max batch size 16, target token latency 300ms) and share in the docs.

I'll join the invites and bring the evaluation checklist.

- Ethan (SE)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@acme.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & next steps — ACME Industries

Alicia — circling to confirm kickoff and logistics.

Calendar: I've proposed Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:00am PT for a 45-min kickoff (agenda attached). Weekly 30-min check-ins on Wednesdays at 10am PT are tentatively scheduled.

Environment: we'll stand up a dedicated hosted pool initially to meet your time-to-value. If you opt for VPC we can convert mid-trial but will need Ben's network contact.

Deliverables we expect to complete ahead of kickoff:
- Redwood: environment provision + credentials, starter evaluation harness, success criteria sheet (completed)
- ACME: sample prompt set + labeled eval dataset, network contact if VPC required, internal stakeholders for final readout

Ethan — can you set up the starter batch config and share the baseline perf expectations by EOD Thursday?

Ben/Alicia — please ACK on kickoff and whether you'll want the VPC option.

Thanks,
Marissa
